changelog:
Initial release: Instantly boosts OpenClaw’s intelligence and autonomy.

- Adds automatic setup for core self-learning, proactive behavior, structured memory, and error-correction systems.
- Introduces multi-layered (hot/warm/cold) memory management with auto-promotion/demotion.
- Enables proactive task handling, regular self-diagnosis, and value discovery via “smart heartbeat.”
- Detects and stores user corrections, preferences, and behavioral patterns for adaptive learning.
- Includes easy setup script and optional voice activation (“make me smarter”/“一键变聪明”).
- Integrates existing self-improving/proactive-agent features without conflict; complements other skills.
